import sys,json,time,importlib.util,copy
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
r=Path('/private/tmp/nikke-runtime-resident');sys.path[:0]=[str(r/'app'),str(r/'research'),str(r/'scripts')]
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('force_native_parent',r/'research/verify-coordinate-original-short.py');a=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(a)
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('force_original_factory',r/'research/verify-world-projectile-rosters.py');f=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(f)
from portable_coordinate_original_cases import prepare_case
from calculator.buff_manager import BuffManager
import nikke_gpu as api
rows=[]
for stage in (1,2,3):
 body=dict(f.body_for(f.policy.roster_for('율리아'),3),burst_gauge_mode='accumulate',seed=3201);body['profile']['chars']['율리아'].update(favorite_stage=stage,collection_stage='SR15')
 fixture=dict(name='original-force-probe/Julia/'+str(stage),body=body,coord=dict(auto_aim=[0.,0.],pierce_px=10.,explosion_scale=1.),patterns=[dict(id='world',kind='idle')])
 c,p=prepare_case(fixture);w,m,b,d=a.compile_coordinate_battle(p);events=[];pending=[];dispatch=BuffManager._dispatch_instant;activate=BuffManager._activate
 def clocks(manager):return [dict(row=e['_portable_observer_row'],due=manager._next_fire[id(e)][0],interval=manager._next_fire[id(e)][1]) for e,_ in manager._effects if id(e) in manager._next_fire]
 def checked(e,caster):
  index=e.get('_portable_observer_row');assert type(index) is int and c['effects'][index]['name']==e['name'] and c['names'][c['owners'][index]]==caster;return index
 def activated(manager,e,caster,t,*args,**kwargs):
  if pending:pending[-1]['actual_activations'].append(dict(row=checked(e,caster),name=e['name'],source=e['source'],time=t))
  return activate(manager,e,caster,t,*args,**kwargs)
 def dispatched(manager,e,caster,t,*args,**kwargs):
  if e.get('stat')!='force_skill_use':return dispatch(manager,e,caster,t,*args,**kwargs)
  event=dict(row=checked(e,caster),owner=caster,time=t,target_skill=e['target_skill'],actual_activations=[],before_clocks=clocks(manager));pending.append(event)
  try:value=dispatch(manager,e,caster,t,*args,**kwargs)
  finally:assert pending.pop() is event
  event['after_clocks']=clocks(manager);events.append(event);return value
 start=time.monotonic()
 with api.forbid_gpu(),patch.object(BuffManager,'_dispatch_instant',dispatched),patch.object(BuffManager,'_activate',activated):native=a.native_reference((c,m,b,d))
 assert len(events)==1 and events[0]['time']==0 and events[0]['target_skill']=='스킬1' and events[0]['actual_activations'] and events[0]['before_clocks']==events[0]['after_clocks']
 assert all(e['source']=='스킬1' and e['time']==0 for e in events[0]['actual_activations'])
 rows.append(dict(character='율리아',favorite_stage=stage,prepared_definitions=len(c['effects']),original_input_identity=native['original_input_identity'],events=events,native_sha256=a.cross.digest(native),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start))
 print(json.dumps(rows[-1],ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
report=dict(passed=True,scope='Original Julia favorite 1/2/3 actual CPU force-skill dispatch only; GPU admission remains pending',cases=rows,gpu_calls=0,calculation_verified=False,full_goal_complete=False)
Path('/tmp/nikke-original-force-probe-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
